lines.rookie: Bongsu's note led to the Emperor's letter in the old pine. It left by the little west gate. You knocked on Yi Jun's door at 6:50, between the watchers' walks. The thread, the way and the times showed Yi Jun that no one saw it. In 1907 three envoys went to The Hague. They went to tell the world the 1905 treaty was forced. They were not let into the conference. Yi Jun died in The Hague. Japan used the envoys as an excuse to force the Emperor off his throne.
lines.junior: Bongsu's note led to the Emperor's letter, hidden in the old pine. It left the palace by the little west gate, and you knocked on Yi Jun's door at 6:50, between the watchers' walks. The thread, the way and the times proved to Yi Jun that no one had seen it. In 1907 three envoys went to The Hague to tell the world the 1905 treaty was forced, but they were not let into the conference. Yi Jun died in The Hague. Japan used the envoys as an excuse to force the Emperor off his throne.
lines.master: Bongsu's note pointed to the Emperor's letter in the old pine. It slipped out by the little west gate, and you knocked on Yi Jun's door at 6:50, in the gap between the watchers' walks. The thread, the route and the timetable convinced Yi Jun that no one had seen it. In 1907 three envoys travelled to The Hague to tell the world the 1905 treaty was forced, but they were refused entry to the conference. Yi Jun died in The Hague, and Japan used the envoys as a pretext to force the Emperor off his throne.

lines.rookie:
The secretary had the Emperor's letter at dusk. Watchers came to the gate.
Footprints leave the path. They go to the trees, not to the steps.
A yellow silk thread is caught on rough bark, at hand height.
By a root, the moss is pushed aside. Someone knelt there.
— Bongsu
lines.junior:
The secretary had the Emperor's letter at dusk. Then watchers came to the gate.
Footprints leave the path. They lead to the trees, not to the steps.
A yellow silk thread is caught on rough bark, about as high as a hand.
By a root, the moss is pushed aside. Someone must have knelt there.
— Bongsu
lines.master:
At dusk the Emperor's letter was in the secretary's hands, and then watchers reached the gate.
Footprints leave the path, heading for the trees and not to the steps.
A yellow silk thread has snagged on rough bark, at the height of a hand.
By a root, the moss has been pushed aside, as if someone knelt there.
— Bongsu

lines.junior: Answer each of his worries with one card.
lines.master: Meet each worry with a single card.

lines.rookie: Watchers are everywhere in Seoul. I must be sure.
lines.junior: There are watchers all over Seoul. I have to be sure.
lines.master: Seoul is full of watchers. I must be certain.

lines.rookie: Then let me show you, one worry at a time.
lines.junior: Then let me show you, one worry at a time, with my evidence.
lines.master: Then allow me to answer each worry in turn.

lines.rookie: Who are the watchers?
lines.junior: Who are the watchers?
lines.master: Who exactly are these watchers?

lines.rookie: Men who report to Japan's officials.
lines.junior: They are men who report to Japan's officials.
lines.master: Men who carry every report to Japan's officials.

lines.rookie: They watch the Emperor and his friends.
lines.junior: They keep watch on the Emperor and his friends.
lines.master: They keep the Emperor and all his friends under watch.

lines.rookie: Yi Jun asks: "Who pulled this thread?"
lines.junior: Yi Jun asks: "Who pulled this thread out?"
lines.master: Yi Jun asks: "Who tore this thread loose?"

lines.rookie: No one pulled it. It caught on the pine's rough bark when he hid it.
lines.junior: No one pulled it. The thread caught on rough bark when the secretary hid the letter in the pine.
lines.master: No one pulled it. The thread snagged on the pine's rough bark as the secretary pushed the letter into the hollow.

lines.rookie: Bongsu saw the thread there. Good.
lines.junior: So Bongsu saw the thread on the tree. Good.
lines.master: Then Bongsu saw the very thread on the tree. Good.

lines.rookie: That does not tell me about the thread.
lines.junior: That tells me nothing about the thread.
lines.master: That says nothing about the thread.

lines.rookie: Which card talks about a yellow thread? Read it again.
lines.junior: Which card mentions a yellow thread? Read it again.
lines.master: Look again for the card that mentions a yellow thread.

lines.rookie: Yi Jun asks: "Watchers stand at every palace gate. Did they see you leave?"
lines.junior: Yi Jun asks: "There are watchers at every palace gate. Did they see you leave?"
lines.master: Yi Jun asks: "Every palace gate is watched. How did you leave without being seen?"

lines.rookie: We left by the little west gate. Bongsu's uncle keeps it.
lines.junior: We went out by the little west gate, which Bongsu's uncle keeps.
lines.master: We slipped out by the little west gate, which Bongsu's uncle keeps.

lines.rookie: Not the front gate. Good.
lines.junior: Not the front gate, then. Good.
lines.master: Not the front gate, where they stand all day. Good.

lines.rookie: That does not show how you left the palace.
lines.junior: That does not show how you got out of the palace.
lines.master: That says nothing of how you left the palace.

lines.rookie: Which card shows your way out of the palace?
lines.junior: Which card shows how you got out of the palace?
lines.master: Look again for the card that traces your way out of the palace.

lines.rookie: Yi Jun asks: "Watchers walk past my door. Did one see you knock?"
lines.junior: Yi Jun asks: "Watchers walk past my door. Did any of them see you knock?"
lines.master: Yi Jun asks: "Watchers walk past my door. Could one have seen you knock?"

lines.rookie: The 6:40 walk takes ten minutes. We knocked at 6:50, when it had passed.
lines.junior: The 6:40 walk takes ten minutes, so we knocked at 6:50, just after it passed.
lines.master: The 6:40 walk lasts ten minutes; we knocked at 6:50, the moment it had passed.

lines.rookie: And the next walk is at 7:20. No one saw you.
lines.junior: And the next walk is not until 7:20. No one saw you.
lines.master: And the next walk comes only at 7:20. No one saw you.

lines.rookie: That does not show when you knocked.
lines.junior: That does not tell me when you knocked.
lines.master: That says nothing of when you knocked.

lines.rookie: Which card has the watchers' times?
lines.junior: Which card shows when the watchers walk?
lines.master: Look again for the card with the watchers' times.

lines.rookie: GIVE YI JUN THE LETTER
lines.junior: GIVE YI JUN THE LETTER
lines.master: GIVE YI JUN THE LETTER

lines.rookie: No watcher saw it. Not at the pine, not at the gate, not at your door.
lines.junior: No watcher saw it: not at the pine, not at the gate, and not at your door.
lines.master: No watcher laid eyes on it, not at the pine, not at the gate, not at your door.
